content.short: DeFi Tools is a suite of DeFi tools including impermanent loss calculators and staking and farming strategies.
content.description: DeFi Tools is a suite of tools for optimized DeFi strategy formulation across CoinGecko and PancakeSwap. Built and supported by Juan Pablo Pisano, the tools provide trading insights before making investments, helping users ground their decisions in data. A featured element is the Top 20 DApps TVL by chain report, which helps track hot tokens by their recent market performance and offers a basis for assessing opportunities and refining investment strategies accordingly.
